entrypoints.description: Grounded Judgment projection owns explicit contemporaneous expectation interpretation from Evidence.

extension_seams: Add generic Judgment kinds/relations when cross-industry evidence proves a truthful representation gap.
Add derived presentation over Judgment/Outcome without mutating original assertions.

guards.description: CI requires Judgment replay/no-lookahead smoke before Pytest.
Judgment targets preserve month/quarter/year/range source precision instead of fake exact dates.

guards.contains: must not manufacture day-level timing error
guards.description: Outcome timing compares only at precision supported by the target and realized outcome.

non_goals: Backfilling later Outcome knowledge into the original Judgment.
Manufacturing exact target dates or day-level timing errors from coarse historical guidance/outcomes.
Using non-direct later Reality implication as a schema field without its recorded promotion gate.
purpose: Own contemporaneous Judgment representation, source-supported target precision, rationale/revision context and later precision-aware Outcome evaluation without rewriting the original historical Judgment.
revisit_when: Only replace if contemporaneous speaker/target/value/target precision/rationale/revision and immutable later Outcome linkage/timing precision remain separately recoverable at historical cutoffs.
title: Judgment, expectation revision and Outcome memory
